checks.name: Desktop requires Google and hides the old password-only login
Legacy password-only WebSocket entry is blocked even with the correct password
Empty verified Google account creates its first character and enters through production WS
Google email, profile name and subject are absent from public game packets and ranking
In-game logout closes the play session and obtains a fresh Google nonce
Returning Google account selects and loads its saved character on a 430px touch viewport
Four saved characters fill the mobile roster; both UI and direct WS reject fifth creation and legacy claim
A different verified Google account cannot select someone else’s character
Claiming a legacy character requires its password after Google verification and preserves level/progress
Claimed legacy character appears in the same Google account’s next login roster
Expired server ticket produces google_retry, clears the roster and recovers through a fresh Google login
Changing Google account clears the roster and password fields and requests a fresh challenge
A stale SDK callback after account change is ignored without a verification request
Cancelled Google popup and empty callback keep login usable; retry succeeds
Rejected Google credential shows a readable mobile error and a successful fresh retry
Missing Google configuration fails closed with an explicit mobile message and no password fallback
Blocked Google SDK shows a readable mobile error and reloads successfully after retry

limits: Real production HTTP/WS app on loopback with isolated in-memory SQLite. Only Google SDK and signature verifier are replaced in explicit QA tooling.
Actual Google account consent, Google signature verification over the network and production OAuth Client ID are not verified here.
Headless Chromium 430px touch and 1440px desktop simulation, not a physical Android device.
